title: Latino Dems urge Democratic Governors Association to put money behind Gina Hinojosa as Texas governor's race tightens - CBS News
description: Latino Democratic leaders are renewing calls for the Democratic Governors Association to invest more heavily in Texas after a new poll showed Gina Hinojosa narrowly leading Republican Gov. Greg Abbott.
